BiblicalUsage: A cistern is a pit for holding water, and this word appears three times, in thirst and in idolatry. In 2 Samuel 23:15 David longs for water from the well of Bethlehem, and in 2 Samuel 23:16 his mighty men break through the Philistines to draw it. In Jeremiah 2:13 God says his people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the broken cistern is one of the saddest pictures in the Bible: men digging their own water-holes while the fountain stands open.
